description: This Java source file defines the ThingEventPubSubFactory class, which extends AbstractPubSubFactory to create pub-sub factories for handling ThingEvent objects within an actor system. It includes methods for creating factories based on shard region extractors, read subjects, and shard IDs, utilizing various extractors and constants.

classes.name: ThingEventPubSubFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating pub-sub components for ThingEvent objects, supporting different configurations based on shard regions, read subjects, and shard IDs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory for thing events using an actor context and shard region extractor.

methods.name: readSubjectsOnly
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory for thing events ignoring shard ID topics.

methods.name: shardIdOnly
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory for thing events ignoring read subject topics, based on number of shards.

methods.name: readSubjectOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Returns a topic extractor for read subjects with constant topics.

methods.name: shardIdOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Returns a topic extractor based on shard ID extractor.

methods.name: toTopicExtractor
methods.description: Combines constant topics and shard ID extractor into a composite topic extractor.
